payload.recallText: Hi I grew up in providence rhode island. MY family lived 20 miles from the kennedy's. They felt like relatives that you know well but never see. We were irish, they were irish. we were catholic, they were catholic. This one thanksgiving we took a drive south and it was the tenth anniversary to the assassination of kennedy so I began to cry. My sister Erin told my dad how i was crying so he pulled the car over on i95, he looked back at me with tears in his eyes too and said to never be ashamed to shed tears for that man. Eventually we make it down to my aunts, and we all go to the beach. My aunts use binoculars to watch and gossip about the kennedy's who were just across the water. They gossiped about Rose. My cousins and I played in the water, eventually we got swept out close enough to see people on passing by ferries. My aunts put down their binoculars and noticed how far out we were. Eventually a power boat pulled up with two of the Kennedy men on board. They brought us back to land where my aunts were not angry for the fact how far out we were, but angry for the fact the kennedys had to bring us back, as if our family didn't give them enough trouble.
